I am a chef and work in a restaurant.
sentences.Jeg lager mat, setter opp menyer og plan: I cook, put together menus and plan purchases. There's a lot to do in the kitchen.
sentences.Gjestene bestiller mat, og vi lager mate: The guests order food, and we cook the food and get it ready to serve.
I work in the evenings and at weekends.
sentences.I dag lager jeg mat til en bryllupsmidda: Today I am cooking for a wedding dinner, and there are lots of guests.
sentences.Det er veldig travelt, for alle gjestene: It is very busy, because all the guests are to get their food at the same time.
sentences.Det er litt slitsomt å være kokk, men de: It is a bit tiring being a chef, but it is a varied and great job, and I really enjoy it.
sentences.Er hovedretten ferdig snart? Bryllupsgje: Is the main course ready soon? The wedding guests have finished the starter now.
Yes, I just have to finish the sauce.
sentences.Skal jeg sette tallerkenene her?: Shall I put the plates here?
sentences.Ja, takk. Jeg legger på kjøtt, grønnsake: Yes, please. I'm putting on the meat, vegetables and potatoes now, and then I add the sauce at the end.
sentences.Har du smakt på sausen? Er den god?: Have you tasted the sauce? Is it good?
sentences.Vent litt, jeg smaker nå. Mm, den er vel: Wait a moment, I'm tasting it now. Mm, it's very good! I hope the bride and groom and the guests will be happy.
